automationNotes: Doc: [Prioritize Experiences](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/prioritize-experiences). **Prereq:** at least **two** experiences in the project (drag reorders the **second** row above the **first**). UI: Experiences listing **`data-testid="experiences-priority-sidebar-trigger"`** → sidebar (`**prioritize-experience-page.html`**, **`generic-sidebar-header`**, **`drag-experience-priority-row`**) → **Save** (`**experiences-priority-sidebar-save`** enables after reorder). **Project card:** `PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS` / `DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`. DOM: `data/dom/Personalize/experiences.html`, `prioritize-experience-page.html`.
